write_scope_revision.narrowed_to: the STAGE_E_SOURCE_MANIFEST_SHA256 constant at local_pilot.py:37-39 and nothing else in that module
write_scope_revision.why: _verify_source_manifest checks the manifest's OWN bytes against that hardcoded constant before checking any per-file entry. F6 adds two manifest entries and F4/F5 change service.py's pinned hash inside the manifest; either edit changes the manifest's bytes and therefore its own digest, invalidating the constant. orchestration_bridge.run() calls preflight_local_pilot on every CLI open/close, so validation command 3 (test_orchestration_bridge) fails with 'Stage-E source manifest digest mismatch' unless the constant moves in the same change.
write_scope_revision.why_not_relocate: local_pilot.py IS the correct owner of manifest verification. Moving the check into service.py would create the cycle service -> local_pilot -> service, since local_pilot imports service and never the reverse. The declared scope was wrong; the logic placement was not.
write_scope_revision.editing_constraint: The manifest must be updated by surgical substitution of the digest token in the raw text, never by json.dumps re-serialization: the file is CRLF on disk and a round-trip is not byte-identical. The constant update must land in the same commit as the manifest content change.
write_scope_revision.evidence: Independently reached by both alignment auditors of dispatch 2026-08-03-swu-aci-host-bus-integrity-001-code (alignment lens and layering lens), each returning NOT PASS before any code was written. That dispatch closed user_abort with the full blocking list in its close record.
write_scope_revision.authority_caveat: This revision and the matching domainspec-code-readiness@1 receipt were authored by the same agent that authored the code contract they are checked against. Nothing in this repository or in the linked DomainSpec package produces a domainspec-code-readiness@1 receipt: the schema has a strict validator (append-dispatch.cjs), two consumers, and two instances, but no producer. The appender's readiness check is therefore SELF-CONSISTENCY, not independent planner evidence. Owner accepted this explicitly on 2026-08-03 rather than treating it as satisfied planner authority.
